title: Coder defaults
summary: The extensions Coder admits for everyone. Each release depends on the adopted extensions' releases and cites the operator's openagents.eval-admission.v1 decision for each.
key: ~/.openagents/nostr/coder-defaults-key on the referee host; created once with microcoder xp defaults-keygen and never copied
documents: packages/coder-defaults/documents/<sha256 hex>.json holds each published manifest and admission, named by the digest its release or manifest pins
